name: High Desert Dental Maverick XC Invitational
where: Grand Junction, CO · host Colorado Mesa · Lincoln Park Golf Course
headline: High Desert Dental Maverick XC Invitational
summary: Final: No. 20 Colorado Mesa's women swept the top three places and beat No. 5 Western Colorado 17-45, with Jordan Staniszewski winning the 6K in 21:09.49 ahead of Autumn McQuitty (21:45.84) and Addison Hollmann (22:02.42). No. 9 Western Colorado won the men's 8K with 18 points to Colorado Mesa's 52 and Fort Lewis's 62, led by Branden Davis (25:02.27) and Wyatt Hoover (25:25.29).
